comparison.objective: Remove an entangled tote from a shelf versus commission a robot-axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Strap disentanglement and tote transfer versus hex-key unlocking, collar tuning, relocking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Tote safely on table with contents retained versus two repeatable, non-bottoming carriage stops and a drift-resistant lock.
comparison.reason: No shared adjustment mechanism or dynamic commissioning test. Candidate rubric leaves rebound, overload, drift tolerance, setscrew torque, and thread-damage thresholds undeclared.
